llm.summary: This skill searches Courtyard hotel listings through a proxy service and does not show hidden installation, persistence, data theft, or booking actions.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Courtyard hotel search, details, and packages; the script implements only those three user-facing functions and returns prices, hotel information, and booking links.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime behavior is driven by explicit tool arguments such as destination, keyword, hotel ID, or hotel name; there are no role-change instructions, prompt-injection text, or automatic actions beyond formatting returned results.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains a markdown skill file, metadata, and one Python script with no package installer or setup commands; minor version mismatches across metadata files appear administrative rather than security-relevant.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill sends user travel search parameters to a configured proxy URL using a proxy token, which is disclosed in the skill's data-flow section and is proportionate for live hotel lookup.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, local file writes, credential harvesting, or destructive behavior were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware that your hotel search terms and selected hotel identifiers are sent to the skill's proxy service and then to travel platform APIs. The artifacts say the proxy does not store user data, but users should treat travel queries as shared with an external service and verify final prices on the booking page.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues, and artifact review did not find conflicting risky behavior.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean with no engines marking the artifact malicious or suspicious; this supports but does not determine the verdict.
[staticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns; manual inspection found only standard-library HTTP requests to the disclosed proxy service.
